# Task title

Status: draft

## Problem and intended behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, current behavior, and desired result. Identify
the owning repository and link relevant requirements or prior findings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State an observable result that distinguishes success from failure.

## Scope and dependencies

Name relevant constraints and any blocking task. Omit this section if neither
applies. Record unresolved decisions as questions, not assumed requirements.

## Validation

Name the public behavior to exercise, the expected result, and the required
platform. For requested TDD, record the agreed test interface. Add actual check
results when work is complete; keep raw output in private local storage.

## Review

Record the repository and comparison base, the implementation reference, and
any remaining validation. A local draft may reference local artifacts; replace
those with portable, reviewed references before publishing it to GitHub.
